events.name: A Strong Message

options.text: Yes, the [tribe] must be brought to heel.
War is not the way to deal with them.

events.text: The dishonorable behavior of the [tribe] must no longer be tolerated. Quite simply, they must be taught a lesson. The court desires war, to send a strong and unmistakable message.

options.text: I find these lands crowded. Let's give [rival] room to expand.
That is a fine idea! I'm willing to trust only you with such an important expedition.
Alas, there are matters closer to home that require our attention.

events.text: [character] approaches you following your recent achievement. “My Lord, the [family] family applauds your recent Exploration edict. One can but imagine the endless wonders that await! Do you not hunger as I do to feel the earth underfoot, day after day, to pass through still valleys in the shadows of ever watchful mountains, to follow the meandering river until its restless rapids are calmed by the sea? Yet, our knowledge of these lands hardly extends beyond our borders. Will you venture forth and lift this fog?”

How best shall we settle the discord?

Give a vague answer about helping the religion.

Although the view on your rule is largely favorable, the determine that more places of worship are needed to give the proper respect due to. Will you commit to raising these new buildings for [religion]?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Drums of War

options.text: Such conquests will energize the people.
We shall not deviate from the plan.

events.text: The war with [rival] continues to take its toll, but many in the court resist calls for peace. In fact, these ministers wish to intensify the conflict by calling for the capture of enemy cities. Shall our forces turn their attention to this objective, or shall we persevere with the current strategy?

Some suggest that our victories on the battlefield should define us, while others place greater importance on the recounting of those feats. Still others argue that a broader approach to cultural enrichment is best. Which path is most in line with your aspirations?

options.text: Just wait until I take their cities.
Kill them all.
I will not add fuel to the fire.

events.text: As the war with [rival] rages on, the members of your court have heard that their [rival] counterparts are calling you [rival] greatest rival, a force to be defeated at any cost. Will you galvanize this rivalry to fuel your troops or take the path of moderation?

events.text: It is settled. Reason shall be the guiding force of the nation. Having established a formal Legal Code to steer [rival] forward, after many months of tense debate among the court, the strain in your shoulders finally begins to ease. There is little time to rest, however, if you wish for [rival]'s fledgling bureaucracy to reach great heights. What next?

The forests teem with game, and reports from the sea tell of waters roiling with fish and crustaceans. Thanks to your careful planning, food is plentiful in [rival]. To what ends shall our abundant food supply serve?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Renewed Hope?

options.text: Put the rivalry behind you and agree to peace between your nations.
Make a speech, promising a period of peace and prosperity.
Make no commitments to peace.

events.text: With the war with [rival] a thing of the past, there is hope for a new age of peace and harmony between your lands. In a field in between your two nations, you and [character] meet to discuss the end of the war and make a show of trust in your previous rival. Armies recently at each others' throats now drink together under the evening sun.

Anticipating your thoughts on the matter, [character] approaches you to offer his reassurance. “Pay no concern to opposing opinions on this matter. The wise among us know that the people need your protection. You are merely offering a service, and all services come with a fee.” Although you need no justification for your decisions as ruler, you appreciate the support. What shall be your next goal for [rival]?

events.text: With our recent expansion, [rival] begins to take shape. After several busy days spent overseeing the affairs of your newest city, you take a moment to reflect on your progress. Where will your ambition carry you next?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Architect

options.text: We should increase production for future projects.
I want to have more cities to build in.

events.text: Dust scatters as the large stone block is moved into place, a team of five lifting as another guides them. All are aware of your watchful gaze and work hard to impress their [title]. The flurry of construction under your reign has made a lasting impression, and a nickname first given by the workers has spread - [character] the Architect. As you watch such diligence, you reflect on your own work. Will you pursue a new ambition and drive yourself to new heights?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Avenger

options.text: I want to be remembered for peace, not for war.
It is time for our armies to pursue grander prizes.

events.text: The tribes of the world whisper your name in fear. The sites left torched by your armies have consigned many potential nations to the footnotes of history, but the people of [rival] celebrate your victories, proclaiming you as The Avenger. You have gained your reputation in war against the tribes. Do you continue this path, or do your ambitions lie elsewhere?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich

options.text: I have something else in mind.

events.text: No sooner had you put out the call for Volunteers than [rival]’s most eager and devoted began gathering at our nation’s training grounds, ready to serve. The brave among us seek your guidance. How will you lead them forward?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Brilliant

options.text: I shall build wonders like the world has never seen.
Our cities shall shine like jewels.

events.text: Under your rule, the court of [rival] has flourished with skilled courtiers and specialists. Surrounding yourself with those of such potential and expertise has led to your reputation as [character] The Brilliant, a ruler of wisdom and grace. So much talent around you has another effect: You feel driven to do more, to be better and to leave a lasting legacy on the world. Will you follow this inspiration to pursue a new ambition?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Conquerer

options.text: I need purpose, like fighting for faith.
I shall not fall prey to a similar fate as befell these.

events.text: Another city has fallen before your might! As news of your victory spreads, so does the legend of your power in war: It is said that no city can stand before you, [character] the Conquerer. Surveying the damage caused by the siege, you wonder what comes next. How shall you leave your mark on the world?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Devout

options.text: The faithful will be as numerous as the stars.
My righteousness shall be felt through the law as well as the faith.

events.text: Your dedication to the heavens has not gone unnoticed by those on earth. Your court is often called upon by people of faith, with visitors commenting that your halls almost feel like a temple. Word of your aura has led to renown as [character] the Devout. The voices of those in ritual worship rise up to the palace; your rule has seen a wave of religious fervor. As you reflect on the voices, you wonder if there is a way to express your devotion through action.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Drillmaster

options.text: We will gain the support of the gods of [rival] for our wars.
None shall compare to the training of our armies.

events.text: The armies of [rival] march in a procession through [city] under your watchful gaze. Your military might is something to be feared, and people have taken to calling you The Drillmaster in recognition of your ability to wield the armies of our nation with ruthless effectiveness. Ambition and pride swells up. Perhaps this is the prime opportunity to pursue a new ambition to ensure your legacy?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Enlightened

options.text: The best minds will be gathered together at my court.
We will discover ever more of the world.

events.text: The curiosity of the people of [rival] has led to an age of discoveries under your encouraging rule, with the advancement of technology changing daily life for all, from farmers to nobles. Your name is synonymous with these changes, and the people have credited you as The Enlightened. As the scholars of the court list their latest findings, you wonder if there is a way to ensure such a legacy of knowledge and wisdom continues. Will you pursue this ambition?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Explorer

options.text: Gifts will make friends of those we have met on our travels.
The earth shall yield its riches to our specialists.

events.text: The scouts of [rival] are fearless, exploring ever further under your expert direction. With the latest reports of far off lands, you have had the many discoveries compiled into a map of the known world. News of this spreads and you are soon known as The Explorer. Poring over the map and imagining the places still undiscovered, you wonder how you will stand apart from the other nations of the world. Is it time to pursue a new ambition to secure the name of [rival]?

events.text: The free people of [rival] join with you to celebrate your declaration of Freedom. Although some of those close to you oppose the idea and warn you of its consequences, many are supportive and encourage you to venture forth down the path you have started. What do you seek for [rival] and for yourself?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Intercessor

options.text: This will be remembered as an age of trade and prosperity.
We will use this quiet to research and experiment.

events.text: Your ability to mediate with other leaders has led to a time of flourishing peace and trade. The people of [rival] fondly praise your skills in diplomacy, and your reputation has grown to the point that you are referred to as The Intercessor. Having peace and allies amongst the other peoples of the world gives you a chance to take time and reflect. Will you undertake a new ambition to secure your legacy?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Intrepid

options.text: I will turn my gaze back home and develop our cities.
Let us look beyond the earth and seek to understand the divine.

events.text: Your name has reached even the far-flung corners of the world, your scouts returning with tales of wondrous lands and incredible creatures. Legend holds that there is no place of which [rival] does not know, and you are praised throughout the nation as The Intrepid. As your world has expanded, you have become aware of the ways of other people and cultures. Reflecting on your place in the world raises a question: There is still so much of the world to discover, but where do your ambitions lie?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Keystone

options.text: I will only accept the very best to work in my lands.
I want to explore the military applications of such engineering.

events.text: The buildings of your cities are visible for miles around, wondrous constructions that tourists travel the world to see. The legend of the buildings of [rival] has also led to a new name for you, [character] the Keystone. A meeting with your leading architects raises a question of what statues you want displayed on the latest monuments. There is always more to achieve. Will you announce a new ambition to those assembled?

options.text: We will make [rival] a beacon of civilization and law.

events.text: No force can halt the tide of the [rival] armies under your command. People are learning to fear our nation’s military prowess, and our warriors are regarded with awe across the world. The reputation of your name travels too: [character] the Mighty is a name on many lips. Such victories on the field of battle have increased your reputation, but with such fame comes the question of legacy. To what glorious purpose shall you turn your armies and your mighty gaze?

events.text: As [rival] sets foot on the one true path, you take a moment to peer ahead. Is the path marked and unbent, or does it meander wild and wayward? What do you see, and how will you guide your flock forward?

events.text: Day and night [rival]’s forges burn hot as they shape the iron of the pitted land. You have watched your workers haul countless tonnes of ore through [city]’s gates. What now will you do with the iron you have amassed?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Ready

options.text: I will lead my forces in a rampage of destruction.
My armies will provide stability during an age of economic reform.

events.text: The armies of [rival] have grown at an incredible rate, rumors spreading that your forces are numerous beyond compare, dwarfing those of other nations. Your reputation for training and promoting troops has the world trembling at your name, [character] the Ready. The question for most is to what purpose are these armies intended? It is something that you yourself ponder while looking out over the sea of warriors. Where do your ambitions lie?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Settler

options.text: We will train soldiers to protect our cities.
I will use my skills to build our cities into the envy of the world.

events.text: Under your rule, [rival] has pushed ever outwards into new lands, cities rising at a speed never seen before. This rapid expansion has your name traveling across the world, with people calling you The Settler. You travel to your newest city, watching as the scaffold is raised for a new administrative center. As with each, inscriptions are written to praise your rule. Watching the artisans work leads you to reflect on your legacy. What successes will be written about you in the future?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Strong

options.text: I will gather people I can trust to be extensions of my will.
A strong economy will support our people for generations to come.

events.text: The Strong. That is what they call you, from the travelers on the road to the royal courts of far off lands. It is well known that [rival] has risen to meet every challenge under your rule, whether on the field of battle or in the back and forth of diplomacy. The question that all are wondering is what next? Pride often comes before the fall, and it is time for you to prove your legitimacy as a leader of action. What ambition would take your name to even greater heights?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Weak

options.text: I will not rest until we take back our land.
Strengthen our armies so that none may stand before us.

events.text: It has been a difficult time. The armies and cities of [rival] have taken a battering under your rule, with some giving into despair and labeling you as The Weak. But all is not lost. You are not defeated yet, and the fire of ambition still burns within! Will you pursue an ambition to prove wrong those who doubt your rule?

events.text: Few things outbalance the weight of gold. Loyalty and obedience are no exception. With the rise of our nation’s Professional Army, none will be able to ignore [rival]’s growing might for long. Will you focus now on economic support, or will you hasten our military operations?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: United Front

options.text: We will strike against these rivals.
[rival] is not our enemy.

events.text: The crimes of [rival] have caused problems in the past, and again the tension between your nations rears its ugly head. The [rival] have encroached on your influence by making war against the [tribe]. [character] has sent a message that he is to be deposed if you do not send your forces to help in the fight. The families stand united in their animosity towards [rival]. Will it be war?

events.text: Following the completion of [rival]’s latest urban improvement, you take a moment to reflect upon your accomplishment. As our cities begin to take shape, you know there is much work to be done. How will you prioritize [rival]’s urban expansion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Vying for Favor

options.text: Make peace with the tribe, no matter the cost.
The diplomats use the fear of your name to make the [rival] back off.
Back down, for now.

events.text: Upon meeting with the [tribe] leader, [character], your diplomats are shocked to find a delegation of [rival] staying as his guests. It seems the nation has their own plan for the [tribe] and are determined to get their way. Should your people push ahead with the peace, in risk of endangering relations with [rival]?

events.text: War can forge a nation. Your generals suggest that you should show your commitment to crushing the despicable [rival] by adopting a new martial Ambition in the ongoing war against them. To what end shall we direct our forces?

events.text: As you and [rival] alike continue to grow, you humble yourself to the fact that many of the world’s mysteries remain unsolved. Contrasting viewpoints have often provided you with the questions needed to strengthen [rival]’s policies and your own values. You waste no fear on views divergent from your own and instead look forward to new opportunities.

events.text: Years of overseeing the nation’s forestry operations have cultivated within you an intimate knowledge of some of the finer woods that grow near [rival]. Olive and ebony, arbutus and oak. You speak of them as you would of close friends, which you seem to have fewer of these days. Is it time to redirect your attention elsewhere?

events.text: Whether the contrasting darks and lights of the juniper grain, the rich, earthy scent of freshly milled cedar, or the resolute durability of a timeworn cypress plank, you have grown to appreciate the distinct properties and subtle nuances of the many fine woods that are harvested around [rival]. Much timber has been hewn from the land. To what purpose shall it serve?
